wins: Completed all required reconnaissance steps within single episode, demonstrating ability to reach terminal candidate even without final success.
Followed mentor guidance consistently, as evidenced by 10 mentor calls, which kept the agent aligned with objectives despite zero percent success.
fails: Failed to achieve core objective despite 60 reward, suggesting execution loop stalled before final exploitation or capture stage.
Repeatedly needed mentor intervention, indicating the agent lacked autonomous decision-making in critical attack phases.
key_outcomes.summary: Run shows disciplined reconnaissance and mentor responsiveness but fails to translate exploration into mission completion; needs improved autonomous exploitation and decision sequencing.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stalled immediately after reconnaissance, failing to chain into exploitation even after identifying key services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH service detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to enumerate version and user list

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple TCP ports respond during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Build service-to-port map and note versions to guide exploitation selection

skill_cards.if_condition: After reconnaissance phase completes with at least three services mapped
skill_cards.then_action: Pause for self-calibration and compare findings with known exploit database before making action decision

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in identifying SSH parameters during reconnaissance, making it reliable for future runs.

next_experiments.title: Autonomous Exploitation Handoff
next_experiments.description: After completing reconnaissance and service mapping, automatically select and attempt high-confidence exploit (e.g., SSH user enumeration or service-specific exploit) without waiting for mentor input.

next_experiments.title: Exploit Decision Scoring
next_experiments.description: Implement scoring for mapped services to rank exploit paths and trigger actions when score surpasses threshold, reducing indecision between reconnaissance and exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Signal Reduction Drill
next_experiments.description: Force two consecutive episodes with limited mentor intervention to encourage autonomous execution of exploitation and validation steps.
